versions.changelog: API key is now optional: search_jobs and get_listing work with no account. Keyless setup comes first.

Remoet v1.4.1 Changelog

- Added direct open job board search; users can now search all jobs without starring companies.
- Increased free plan limits: 50 active stars, no paid tiers required.
- Updated documentation to clarify the distinction between open catalogue search and starred company feeds.
- Expanded description and instructions in SKILL.md for easier setup and improved onboarding.
- Removed skill-card.md file.
Drop the 5 application-lifecycle tools (now unlisted on the MCP server); apply_to_job covers scraped jobs by returning the application URL

Tech-stack claim now states what holds up: derived from roles each company is hiring for now, not stale self-reported adoption lists. apply_to_job guidance corrected - it returns external application links, it does not fail on scraped jobs.
Onboarding links point at the agent door (mode=agent). Job-data delay retired on all tiers. Real MCP request limits. New get_feed tool documented. Digests marked historical, prefer get_feed.
Discovery-tuned description and topical tags. Unified cross-harness SKILL.md (now also serves Hermes and other MCP clients from one file).
Fix tool name: change_plan -> get_upgrade_link (change_plan never existed as a registered MCP tool). Setup steps unchanged.
Drop drift-prone vanity counts (no more '48 tools' in verify step, no '30 to 50 companies' in intro). Setup steps and tool descriptions unchanged.
